name: IconLinkButton
description: `IconLinkButton` is an icon-only navigation link with the visual treatment and tooltip behavior of `IconButton`. It requires an accessible name from either `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: description
props.description: Supplementary tooltip text, exposed as the link's accessible description.

props.name: keybindingHint
props.description: Keyboard shortcut or alternatives shown in the tooltip; consumers still register the shortcut.

props.name: notificationIndicator
props.description: Shows a visual activity dot on the link boundary or icon. Describe its meaning in the name or description.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the link is activated.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders the link as your own element, for a router link that still needs button styling.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the link.

props.name: tooltipDirection
props.description: Side and alignment of the tooltip relative to the link.

props.name: unsafeDisableTooltip
props.description: Skips the default tooltip. The tooltip is also skipped inside an existing Tooltip.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight of the link. Use `primary` for the main action and `danger` for a destructive one.
